title: ai.m17_doctrine
description: M17 § 'AI doctrine — power + oxygen-aware'. Fires when a bot's power/heat/vacuum-aware doctrine changes: low_battery (power < 20% → retreat to charge), thermal_retreat (throttled / heat >= 70% → retreat from heat source), no_breathable_atmosphere (organic bot lacks sealed helmet / O2 in vacuum), power_shed (power < 40% → shed utility equipment, keep weapon).
